description: As a HansePack client I want to calculate the quote for valid reference cases using HP-V1 rule version so that the pricing is accurate and matches the 14 valid cases

acceptance_criteria.description: All 14 valid reference cases pass with exact line values and totals
All money values are integers in cents (no floats or decimals)

description: As a HansePack client I want to handle invalid input cases with clear error messages so that the system raises `QuoteError` for all 10 invalid cases

acceptance_criteria.description: All 10 invalid cases raise `QuoteError` with non-empty understandable messages
No quotation is produced for invalid inputs

description: As a developer I want a reproducible CLI entry point so that `python -m quotation.pricing` accepts JSON input and prints results to stdout

acceptance_criteria.description: CLI command `python -m quotation.pricing` parses JSON input and returns 0 on success
CLI prints `Fehler: <message>` to stderr on error with exit code 2

description: As a HansePack client I want the pricing calculation to follow HP-V1 rules for discounts and shipping so that the net amounts are correctly computed

acceptance_criteria.description: Discounts applied per line based on tier boundaries (49/50, 99/100) with ROUND_HALF_UP
Shipping calculated as 1200 cents if goods net < 50000 cents, otherwise 0
